note: IP-neutral. What each kind of planet is (issue #45). Read by src/systems/planets/planet_gen.gd. ground: 'terrain' = the town sits on the seamless dune terrain (DesertTerrain), recoloured by 'sand' and 'rock'; 'platform' = the town floats on a deck closed underneath, inside a glass enclosure rising from its walls, with an energy shield across the open gate, over 'surface' (water, lava or gas), and falling off the deck kills you (you wake by the bay); 'ball' (issue #99, the asteroid) = the planet is a real ball of surface.radius like the home planet (src/systems/planets/asteroid_sphere.gd): cratered rock all the way round, gravity toward its centre, flown round and walked round; with 'enclosed' the station is sealed under a dome (src/systems/planets/asteroid_world.gd, 'station'). landing_bay 'pit': the port's round landing pit outside the gate instead of bays inside the walls. space.handoff: how close to this ball (metres above its surface) its own scene takes over from its parent's, with no fade. sky: values laid over every time-of-day preset in content/look/time_of_day.json (only the keys given change). atmosphere: where the sky darkens and space begins, in metres. body: how the planet looks from space (a neighbour's sky), radius in metres. arrival: where a ship coming in from space appears (above the landing bay, metres). default_style: the town style when the planet's own config gives none (content/look/town_styles.json). natives (issue #96, terrain planets only): the people template (content/core/species/) each planet of the type turns into a people of its own, how many packs of what size, how many hostile, with children or adults only, how far out their routes run, and the wild animals (content/core/fauna/); a planet's own 'natives' block replaces this (false = none). See src/systems/natives/natives_data.gd. base (issue #272): a type may name another and give only what differs (dictionaries merge key by key, anything else replaces; PlanetGen._with_base).

gas_ball.label: gas giant

surface.note: The ringed giant: a real ball of gas (src/systems/planets/gas_sphere.gd) you fly round, the town on a floating deck on top (deck: PlatformWorld, as on a platform world). radius is the deck's level; the smooth cloud tops are depth metres below it all the way round. A ship more than lethal_depth metres below the deck's level is down in the clouds and lost (a crash: towed back to its bay); falling off the deck kills you on the way down.

space.note: As the asteroid's: within handoff metres of the cloud tops its own scene flies you, with no fade.

gas_ball.fall_text: You went over the edge and down into the clouds.

station.note: Issue #99: the station is sealed (the locals cannot breathe outside): a round wall under a glass dome, a shield door in the gate, a windowed hallway lit along its ceiling from the gate to the landing pit, through a door in the pit's tall round liner, over the pit's ramp to a round shield; and a shield over the pit itself (its liner 10 m tall, lowered from 13). A planet's own 'domes' add more domes off the pit, each with its own tunnel (town_kit.json 'domes'). Metres; dome_height is its height over the wall's radius.

space.note: Issue #99: no fade between planets. Within handoff metres of this ball's surface its own scene flies you (switched in mid-flight, the ship where it was, the same sun and stars); further out you are in its parent's (near) sky.

harmful_surface.text: Put on armour to roam this planet's surface.
harmful_surface.note: Issue #298: no air on the rock. Outside the dome, the hallway and the landing pit, without armour on, you lose damage_per_s health a second, a straight line to death, reminded every remind_s seconds. A planet's own harmful_surface replaces this; {} turns it off. Read by src/systems/world/harmful_surface.gd.

lava_moon.note: Issue #272: the second ball, a moon of lava rock. Everything not given here is the asteroid's (PlanetGen: 'base'). The rock is dark basalt with less broad swell and taller bumps, so it breaks into islands; surface.lava fills the low ground: 'cover' is the share of the open ground under the lava (the level is worked out from the ball itself: AsteroidSphere.lava_level), none within keep_clear metres of the port (the station, its hallway and the pit). Lava kills on contact, with the platform's fall and respawn (AsteroidWorld) and fall_text. haze: the heat shimmer over the ground round the camera, only below max_altitude metres (src/systems/look/lava_haze.gd). Drawn by src/systems/look/shaders/lava_rock.gdshader, not the sand or moon rock shader.
lava_moon.label: lava moon
